Swarming Morphogenesis Evolution (SwarmEvo)
	

Forecasting the evolution of bacterial swarming colonies is a challenging task. Unlike conventional natural scenes, swarming expansion is governed by the propagation of irregular, anisotropic morphological fronts rather than by appearance continuity or pixel-level motion.
